name: motion
description: Use your phone as a full-body motion controller for a browser game.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter motion-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter motion-web run typecheck
scripts.quality:swift: pnpm run quality:swift-format && pnpm run quality:swift-unused
scripts.check:landing: pnpm --dir site install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir site check
scripts.quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:landing && pnpm quality:coverage && pnpm quality:unused && pnpm quality:complexity && pnpm quality:duplication && pnpm quality:cycles && pnpm quality:dependencies && pnpm quality:suppressions && pnpm quality:hygiene
scripts.deploy: echo 'Motion landing deploys from ios-landings (pnpm run deploy:motion).' && exit 1
